source_issue.title: 共享 Claim IR schema 工件缺失

authority_boundary.required_interpretation: This is an evidence index and proposed disposition only. Kernel/M3* must issue a distinct owner closure record before SI-LLM-001 may be treated as closed.

schema_and_contract.owner_acceptance_evidence: The effective consumer contract accepts this exact path and SHA as the external Claim IR schema identity.

candidate_guard_and_fixture_evidence.scope_caveat: Local candidate guard fixture; owner must decide whether it satisfies the requested Kernel-owned minimum fixture.

comparison_to_original_issue.original_concern: No schemas directory or shared Claim IR JSON Schema exists.
comparison_to_original_issue.basis: Both the external envelope and Kernel schema paths exist with pinned content SHA-256 values.

comparison_to_original_issue.original_concern: No stable schema id, version, or hash exists.
comparison_to_original_issue.basis: Both schemas expose stable ids and byte hashes; the effective consumer contract accepts the external-envelope identity and version.
comparison_to_original_issue.owner_attention: The accepted external envelope retains schema id https://project05.invalid/schemas/claim-ir-kernel.schema.json while the Kernel schema has https://project05.local/schemas/claim-ir-kernel.schema.json. Kernel/M3* must explicitly decide whether this established split identity is sufficient for closure.

comparison_to_original_issue.original_concern: Canonical predicate/entity references and candidate lifecycle/authority fields are not defined.
comparison_to_original_issue.basis: The Kernel schema defines entityRef, claimObject, pointer, certificationAuthority, kernelClaim, and candidate request/proposal/response definitions; the external envelope separately freezes the admitted package surface.

comparison_to_original_issue.original_concern: Minimum valid candidate and authority-leak invalid fixture are absent.
comparison_to_original_issue.basis: Pinned local valid/invalid candidate fixtures and their fail-closed contract test exist, and an exact admitted package is accepted by the effective consumer contract.
comparison_to_original_issue.owner_attention: Owner must decide whether the local candidate fixtures count as the requested Kernel-owned fixtures or whether owner-minted replacements are required.

comparison_to_original_issue.original_concern: A candidate dict cannot be shown to pass an actual Kernel consumption chain without silent promotion.
comparison_to_original_issue.basis: One exact 41-claim package has a byte-pinned admitted, ingested, Kernel intake, E_case, certificate, and CERTIFIED_STOP chain with separate records, receipts, contracts, and exhausted single-use authorities.
comparison_to_original_issue.not_a_generalization: This exact-chain evidence is not blanket eligibility for arbitrary future LLM candidate output.

not_proven_by_exact_fixture: automatic admission or ingestion of new packages
legacy CandidateClaimEnvelope conversion for every producer
permission to bypass schema, admission, authority, receipt, or idempotency gates
candidate_llm_output_into_kernel.owner_question: Should these generalized producer/runtime questions remain within SI-LLM-001, or be tracked as separate follow-on issues after artifact-absence closure?

closure_does_not_authorize: four-family LLM training, fine-tuning, or output ingestion
new Kernel store, E_case, certificate, or CERTIFIED_STOP execution
reactivation, retry, resume, fallback, or reuse of any exhausted activation
Checker invocation, evidence-sufficiency assertion, or promotion

accept_and_close.precondition: Kernel/M3* accepts the dual-schema identity split, existing candidate fixtures, and exact executed-chain evidence as sufficient for the original artifact-absence scope.
accept_and_close.required_output: A new owner-authored closure record with its own artifact_id, version, path, content SHA-256, decision, scope, and explicit non-authorizations.

request_revision.use_when: Owner requires revised schema identity, owner-minted valid/invalid fixtures, additional tests, or corrected evidence pins.

keep_open_with_reason.use_when: Owner decides generalized candidate-producer-to-Kernel proof remains part of SI-LLM-001 rather than a follow-on issue.
keep_open_with_reason.required_output: State the unmet closure condition and the exact additional artifact or test required.
